teamRules: Rule 1: No two girls (Varshini, Vyshnavi) are in the same team.
Rule 2: Koushik and Tanishque are strictly separated across all divided teams.
Rule 3 (No Partiality & No Offense): Every divided hackathon features a completely unique combination of members, so everyone gets equal opportunity to work with different partners fairly.

Rule 4 (Flexibility & Comfort): If anyone feels uncomfortable with their assigned team or wishes to request a partner change, say so openly so the group can readjust. The goal is for everyone to collaborate happily.
